description: HyRAM+ combines fuel-release and flame models with equipment failure probabilities and consequence models for hydrogen, methane and propane infrastructure. It calculates risk measures and compares system designs. The provider is Sandia National Laboratories. Coverage: The toolkit applies to user-defined facilities and release scenarios. It is not a regional asset dataset; time and spatial assumptions vary by calculation. Access: The provider links Windows and macOS installers and Python package sources. None were downloaded. Licence and cost: Sandia identifies an open-source licence and public code and package routes. The exact licence text was not inspected. Limitations: Sandia reports experimental model validation. This review did not independently check it, and the toolkit does not by itself establish safety for a specific facility. For simulation it supports facility-risk comparisons and safety-related sensitivity studies. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
